text.body:
prayogamañjarī
prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ buddherātmabhuvopyabhūmimamalaṃ yattatvamāhurbudhāḥ bhedo yasya jaganmayasya bahudhāpyaupādhiko lakṣyate | dehe svāpacitikramānabhidadhe mantrātmabhiḥ śreyase yo vā dehabhṛtāṃ himācalasutānāthāya tubhyaṃ namaḥ || 1 || janayatu hṛdi saukhyaṃ vastuhinakarakalāvibhūṣaṇo devaḥ | yasya jagattrayamakhilaṃ dhāmnā kalayā kayāpi niyūḍham || 2 || yebhyaḥ praṇāmavidhibhissakṛdapyupāttaissaṃsārasāgarataraṅganimajjamānāḥ | dhvastāndhakāramanaso manujāstarantitebhyo namostu niyataṃ gurupādukebhyaḥ || 3 || jñānāgnidagdhaduritaviṣayapramuktai mūrdhnā dhṛtā sakalayogibhirādareṇa | ye sarvalokamahitā manasaḥ prasādaṃ puṣṇantu te gurupadāmbujapāṃsavo vaḥ || 4 || uddāmatā na vacaso na ca kauśalaṃ me buddheḥ śivasya ca na boddhumalaṃ hi tattvam | …
